parsed.explanation: The counterexample mechanism is valid: all sets in the displayed family intersect through c2, while transversals avoiding c2 correspond to {c1} together with finite transversals of G; suitable G have infinitely many incomparable minimal finite transversals. The induction also unjustifiably restricts to transversals meeting C in its generalized assertion. Thus the finite-list lemma is false, and the later finite-union and periodicity argument lacks the required finiteness foundation. Repair requires replacing the lemma with a valid all-terms large-prime-erasure argument establishing L6.2.
